senses.gloss:
आ-सक्त (क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
a. Diligent; at-
tached, confiding; eternal.

अ-सक्ति (क्तिः) 2.
f. Detachment from
worldly objects.

आ-सक्ति (क्तिः) 2.
f. Attachment to
one object or pursuit.

अशन (नः)
m. A plant.
n. Food.

असन (नः) 1.
m. A tree, (Pentap-
tera tomentosa.)

आ-सन्न (न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
a. Near.
m. The
declining or setting sun.

अशन-पर्णी (र्णी)
f. A plant, (Marsi-
lea quadrifolia.)

आसानी (नी) 3.
f. Stay; a shop; stool.

अषाढ (ढः) 1.
m. The month Ashāḍha
(June--July); student's stuff.
f.
(ढा) 20th and 21st lunar mansions

आशाढ (ढः) 1.
m. The month
Āshāḍha, (June-July.) (ढा)
f.
21st and 22nd lunar mansions.

अ-संस्थान (नं) 1.
n. Want; disorder.
Also असंस्थितिः
f.

अ-संहत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Loose. 1.
m.
Form of array, loose open order.

असकृद्-गर्भवास (सः) 1.
m. Repeated
birth in successive ages.

अ-सङ्कल्प (ल्पः) 1.
m. Want of de-
sign or contrivance.

अ-सङ्कुल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Open, broad,
clear.
m. A broad open road.

अ-सङ्केत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Unfixed, un-
settled, not appointed.

अ-सङ्गत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Uneven, un-
connected with, incongruous.

अ-सत् (न्-ती-त्)
a. Non-existent, un-
real, untrue; bad, vile.

अ-सती (ती) 3.
f. A disloyal or
unchaste woman.

असत्-परिग्रह (हः) 1.
m. Receiving
presents unfit or from improper
persons.

असत्य-वादिन् (दी-दिनी-दि)
a. Speak-
ing falsehood; a liar.

असद् (द्) 5.
m. A name of Indra.

असद्-वृत्ति (त्तिः) 2.
f. Bad, degrad-
ing employment; wickedness.

असद्-व्यवहार (रः) 1.
m. Bad practice
or conduct.

अ-सन्नद्ध (द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
a. Born; con-
ceited; unarmed.

अ-सन्निकृष्ट (ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
a. Remote,
not brought near; unperceived.

अ-सपिण्ड (ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
a. Unconnected
in funeral rites, not related.

अ-सम (मः) 1.
m. Buddha.
a. Un-
equal, unparalleled.

अ-समञ्जस (सं)
n. Unconformity; dis-
parity, difference.

अ-समर्पित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Unconsign-
ed, not delivered.

अ-समवायिन् (यी-यिनी-यि)
a. Acci-
dental, not inherent.

अ-समाप्ति (प्तिः) 2.
f. Incomplete-
ness, unfinished state.

अ-समावर्त्तक (कः)
m. An unfinished
or imperfect student.

अ-समाहार (रः) 1.
m. Loss, disjunc-
tion, unconnectedness.

अ-समाहार्य्य (र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
a. Not to
be found; not to be united.

अ-समीक्ष्य-कारिन् (री-रिणा-रि)
a. Act-
ing carelessly or inconsiderately.

अ-समृद्धि (द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
a. Unfortu-
nate, destitute of wealth.

अ-सम्पर्क (कः-का-कं)
a. Unconnect-
ed, not belonging to.

अ-सम्भव (वः-वा-वं)
a. Improbable.
n.
Extraordinary event.

अ-सम्मूढ (ढः-ढा-ढं)
a. Of clear per-
ception; sedate.

अ-सरु (रुः) 2.
m. A medicinal plant,
(Conyza lacera.)

आशल (लः) 1.
m. A tree, as आशनः.

अ-सवर्ण (र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
a. Of another
caste or colour.

अ-सहन (नः) 1.
m. An enemy.
n.
Intolerance.
a. Unable to bear.

अ-साक्षिन् (क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि)
a. Incompe-
tent as evidence or witness.

अ-साक्ष्य (क्ष्यं) 1.
n. Want of evi-
dence or witness.

अ-साधन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Destitute of
means.
n. Non-accomplishment.

अ-साधित (तः-त-तं)
a. Unaccom-
plished, not effected.

अ-साधुवृत्ता (त्ता) 1.
f. An unchaste
profligate woman.

अ-सार (रः-रा-रं)
a. Sapless; vain;
weak.
n. Castor oil tree.

अ-सारता (ता) 1.
f. Vanity, weak-
ness; decrease of valve, loss.

अ-साहार्य्य (र्य्यं) 1.
n. Want of co-
operation or assistance.

आ-शंसन (नं) 1.
n. Wishing, expect-
ing; declaring.

आशया_श (शः) 1.
m. A name of fire.

आशा_प्राप्त (प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
a. Having the
thing hoped for.

आशा-बन्ध (न्धः) 1.
m. A spider's
web; confidence, expectation.

आषाढ-भव (वः) 1.
m. Planet Mars.
a. Of the month Āshāḍha.

आसक्त-चित्त (त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
a. Of fixed
mind, devoted to, absorbed in.

आसन्द (न्दः) 1.
m. A name of Vish-
nu; (न्दः-न्दी) a small couch.

आसव-द्रु (द्रुः) 2.
m. The palmyra
tree, which yields spirits.

आ-सादन (नं) 1.
n. Obtaining, ac-
companying, going towards.

असङ्गिन् (ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि)
a. Alone, not
attached to the world.

असज्जिता-त्मन् (त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
a. Free
from ties or attachments.
